bios.size: The BIOS must be a 128 KiB BIN file.
bios.readFailed: Cannot read the BIOS. Please select it again.
bios.help: Upload each region once. Region is detected from the file, regardless of its name. Uploading again replaces that region for future releases; existing games keep their BIOS.
bios.title: Shared Mega CD BIOS
bios.saved: BIOS stored. New games will select it automatically by region.
bios.automatic: The disc region automatically selects a BIOS from the shared library above. No per-game BIOS upload is needed.
bios.useLatest: Use the current shared BIOS for this region
